lines: Even when not invoked, seen — the accomplishment of samaya-status of the good; that is said in the Mālinī-tantra: accomplished samaya-maṇḍala.
l4.sanskrit_cite: anāhūte@pi dṛṣṭaṃ satsamayitvaprasādhanam taduktaṃ mālinītantre siddhaṃ samayamaṇḍalam
